questTitle: Run a Half Marathon on my 39th bday
statusStatement: Another interval-training session is reported completed toward the half marathon. Completion of this week's long run and two-run target is not established.
whatMattersNow: Establish whether this week's long run and two-run routine have been completed.
outcomeStatement: I will run a half marathon on 20 November 2026, my 39th birthday, while building a sustainable baseline of one long run and one interval run each week.
quote: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.

statusStatement: The fence is recorded as complete, and a driveway quote has been requested. Quote receipt or acceptance, driveway construction, gate installation, overkapping, and carport ground completion are unconfirmed.
whatMattersNow: Install the ordered gate, which precedes measuring and finalizing the overkapping.
outcomeStatement: I will create a finished, functional outdoor area with the fence and gate, overkapping, driveway, and carport ground completed.
quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.

statusStatement: Bike hangers have been installed and the bikes are hung, adding to previously reported TV and speaker mounting. Lighting, electrical finishing, ventilation, audiovisual testing, and space for a future rower remain unconfirmed.
whatMattersNow: Complete the outstanding lighting and electrical finishing.
outcomeStatement: I will create a finished, clean Zwift-focused garage gym with working electrics, ventilation, lighting, audiovisual equipment, and room for a future rower.
quote: Without continual growth and progress, such words as improvement, achievement, and success have no meaning.

statusStatement: A materials pickup is reported, but the items are unspecified. No installation or finishing task is newly confirmed complete.
whatMattersNow: Confirm that the awaited furniture, wall plates, and other finishing materials are available.
outcomeStatement: I will finish the downstairs toilet as a fully usable, intentional space with completed ventilation, lighting, walls, niche, furniture, and clean finishing details.
quote: The details are not the details. They make the design.

statusStatement: Today's food and drink report does not establish a calorie surplus or body-fat setback. Sustained six-hour training weeks and progress toward 12% body fat cannot be assessed without Workouts totals and a new Withings measurement.
whatMattersNow: Use Workouts totals and a new Withings Body Scan measurement to assess training volume and body-fat progress.
outcomeStatement: I will sustain at least six training hours per week using Workouts as the source of truth and reduce body fat from about 16% to 12% on my Withings Body Scan.
quote: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
